fact: Data centres dataset: Sipopo Datacenter (GITGE (Gestor de Infraestructuras de Telecomunicaciones de Guinea Ecuatorial)), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2025-07-01).
CNIAPGE reported hosting the state's Sidunea platform in its data centre in 2025, and plans to expand the data centre's capacity in 2027.
